name: Golddigger
description: B2B Lead Intelligence MCP Server — search, score and report on B2B leads. Scoring and report generation run fully locally; only search touches the API (customer's own key, customer's own cost).

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check service health + real account quota (GET /api/health + GET /api/quota)

tools.name: check_quota
tools.description: Quota pre-flight: server remaining + local daily budget ledger. Call before any batch search.

tools.name: search_leads
tools.description: Search B2B leads by buyer-intent keyword + country (POST /api/search, costs 1 quota per call, supports dry_run)

tools.name: score_lead
tools.description: Six-dimension lead quality scoring — fully local, no API call

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Radar chart + Word client profile report — fully local, no API call
